api_rules: Only exact STATUS_SUCCESS plus valid returned handle is an owned completed open.
STATUS_PENDING is never completion; no query or wait/retry/fallback. Unknown output/context retained until process exit.
NtOpenFile nonpending return is authoritative; IO_STATUS_BLOCK is not substituted for it.
Each known device/token handle and successful SDDL allocation is consumed before its sole CloseHandle/LocalFree; unknown close never retried.
SD/ACL/SID raw extents are checked before pointer casts. Unsupported ACE layouts remain uninterpreted.
Safe summary emits only fixed known builtin/network/registryRead SID names; unknown user SID and raw SDDL/SD are not emitted.
deadline: Only explicit parent absolute QPC/F; original deadline sampled before/after observations; never now+15s.
fixed_output: afd-device-dacl-readonly-01.json (fresh xb; existing output refuses before any native call)

implicit_winsock_import_avoided.avoided_chain: Local module -> controller -> pipe_helpers -> proof -> smoke -> socket
implicit_winsock_import_avoided.fact: Windows _socket module execution invokes os_init/WSAStartup. Helper refuses socket/_socket in sys.modules.
implicit_winsock_import_avoided.imported_identity_backend: ordinary-launcher NativeAPI (same base inherited by LocalNativeAPI)

limits: Synchronous native APIs cannot be forcibly cancelled by internal deadline checks; parent external process watchdog is required.
No EA, IOCTL, Winsock call, socket API, ACL write, privilege/token edit, profile/process creation or adaptive target fallback.
An AFD device DACL read is not a trace of the failed socket path, a held-LPAC effective-access result, or proof of AFD internal endpoint absence.
No network, fixed-peer, isolation or product qualification is inferred.
supervision: Parent supplies held ordinary atomic Job supervision, suggested20s root/15s work. Helper does not self-spawn.
